title: Resolve SCHC insertion build diagnostic
description: Actual native_sim signed TCP L2 integration build fails GCC13 -Werror=null-dereference at schc_session_table.c:161-165 and231-233. Tombstone/floor insertion assumes cached count below capacity guarantees an unoccupied slot, but scan can leave slot NULL and writes are unconditional. Normal serialized initialization appears to maintain invariant; no radio exploit claimed. Make unresolved-slot handling explicit consistent with neighboring context allocator, preserving existing valid-state behavior, high-water updates and eviction policy. Do not suppress diagnostics.
acceptance_criteria: Optimized native_sim build passes this diagnostic; existing14 session table tests remain passing with sanitizers; minimal source change and three independent reviews; no policy changes.
close_reason: Explicit unresolved-slot guards preserve SCHC valid-state policies and unblock optimized C build.14/14 sanitizer host tests pass; signed native_sim probe passes; three independent reviews clear.
